va-43-04-toc.method: TOC container cost uses the same issue-wide expanded action/listing inventory as its PDF; merged PDF/TOC charged once.
va-43-04-toc.read_pool_definition: Complete retained notices/actions. Annual catalogue pointer rows receive accounting but are not themselves complete notices/actions or supplied linked guidance texts.

participation_read_method.word_cost: max(2, ceil(preamble/participation words / 250) + 1); retain original one-minute check and two-minute minimum
participation_read_method.b_cost: word cost + residual search hits + 2 minutes overhead; median of individual eligible-item costs per container, not separately combined medians
participation_read_method.passages: All pre-body heading/preamble/summary paragraphs and later textbl/textbi/summary preamble-style paragraphs; text outside paragraph nodes is charged as heading/preamble. Whole Parts/Articles/VAC sections whose headings match participation keywords; each other paragraph matching comment*, hearing*, petition*, effective, date(s), objection*. Other notices/no reliable body boundary conservatively read whole.
participation_read_method.search: Remaining native text only: nonoverlapping comment*, hearing*, objection*, ISO dates, numeric month/day/year or month-day-year, month-name/day dates and standalone 19xx/20xx years. Year-like legislative/code citations deliberately count as possible dates. Bare slash fractions (1/3, 1/6) are excluded. Each occurrence costs one minute, even repeated; context is its paragraph and adjacent paragraphs, deduplicated only for context word reporting.
participation_read_method.pdf: HTML counterpart closest to median full-body size supplies structured passage counts where available; PDF-only native blocks use lines/blank lines and VAC boundaries. Counts are sizing estimates, not completed human reads.

limitations: Counts are displayed source items, not accepted entity counts or sums of completion fields.
PDF/TOC share expanded issue-wide items, not just top-level TOC headings. Display-repeated HTML actions remain separate accounting rows; PDF counts native action closings once.
PDF-only native-action lengths use native closing-marker segments; no-number HTML counterparts may not match native PDF heading order. These are flagged sizing candidates, not adjudicated identities.

Annual guidance catalogue rows contribute separate accounting items. They are excluded from the one-complete-notice/action read pool: a pointer row is not the full linked guidance text. Complete guidance publication notices remain eligible. This nested population definition must be reviewed before any future seed.
No item was drawn and no seed generated. A future item frame must resolve flagged residuals and full-item/linked-document boundaries before sampling.
